import boto3
qs = boto3.client("quicksight")

for dataset_id in ["caldera_installation_performance",
                    "caldera_monthly_billing"]:
    qs.create_ingestion(
        DataSetId=dataset_id,
        IngestionId=f"refresh-{dataset_id}-{context.aws_request_id}",
        AwsAccountId=ACCOUNT_ID,
    )
